parts: If your car goes off a bridge and into a lake...
you have about sixty seconds to get out.
caps: IF YOUR {y:CAR} GOES OFF A BRIDGE|AND INTO A {r:LAKE}...
YOU HAVE ABOUT {r:60 SECONDS}|TO GET OUT.

parts: Night. Ice on the road. You swerve...
and the car hits the water nose first.
caps: NIGHT. {y:ICE} ON THE ROAD.|YOU SWERVE...
AND THE CAR HITS THE WATER|{r:NOSE FIRST}.

parts: For a moment, it floats.
And most people waste that moment doing the wrong thing.
caps: FOR A MOMENT, {y:IT FLOATS}.
AND MOST PEOPLE WASTE IT|DOING THE {r:WRONG THING}.

parts: Rule one: seatbelt off. Right now.
Then yell at everyone else to do the same.
caps: {y:RULE 1}: {y:SEATBELT OFF}. RIGHT NOW.
THEN YELL AT EVERYONE|TO DO THE SAME.

parts: Rule two: forget the door. The water pressure holds it shut.
Open the window, while the power still works.
caps: {y:RULE 2}: {r:FORGET THE DOOR}.|THE WATER HOLDS IT SHUT.
OPEN THE {y:WINDOW}|WHILE THE POWER STILL WORKS.

parts: Rule three: if it won't open, break a side window, near the corner.
Never the windshield. It's built not to shatter.
caps: {y:RULE 3}: STUCK? BREAK A {y:SIDE WINDOW},|NEAR THE CORNER.
{r:NEVER THE WINDSHIELD}.|IT'S BUILT NOT TO SHATTER.

parts: Kids in the back? They go out first.
Oldest first, so they can help the little ones.
caps: KIDS IN THE BACK?|{y:THEY GO OUT FIRST}.
{y:OLDEST FIRST},|SO THEY CAN HELP THE LITTLE ONES.

parts: The deadly mistake?
Grabbing your phone to call nine one one first.
caps: THE {r:DEADLY MISTAKE}?
GRABBING YOUR PHONE|TO {r:CALL 911} FIRST.

parts: By the time someone answers, the water is at your chest.
Get out first. Call from the shore.
caps: BY THE TIME THEY ANSWER,|THE WATER IS AT {r:YOUR CHEST}.
{y:GET OUT FIRST}.|CALL FROM THE SHORE.

parts: So you do it right. Window down. You climb out.
You swim up and grab the roof. You made it.
caps: SO YOU DO IT RIGHT.|WINDOW DOWN. {y:YOU CLIMB OUT}.
YOU GRAB THE ROOF.|{y:YOU MADE IT}.

parts: Then you hear it. Knocking.
From inside the trunk.
But you were driving alone.
caps: THEN YOU HEAR IT. {r:KNOCKING}.
FROM INSIDE {r:THE TRUNK}.
BUT YOU WERE {r:DRIVING ALONE}.
